request.text:
The logs should ideally capture the following details:

1. **AI Tool & Model:** Tool and model used (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.).
2. **Agent Details:** Agent type (built-in/custom/sub-agent) and execution mode (Ask/Plan/Agent/Edit).
3. **Prompt & Interactions:** Actual queries/prompts submitted to the agent, including follow-up interactions.
4. **Skills & Sub-agents:** Skills invoked, custom instructions followed, and any sub-agents utilized.
5. **Tools & Integrations:** MCP servers, external tools, or other capabilities accessed.
6. **AI Actions & Outputs:** Tasks performed, code generated/modified, tests created, and other deliverables.
7. **Human Intervention:** Manual changes, decisions, corrections, and validation performed.
8. **Execution Evidence:** Timestamps, affected files, test results, and relevant session/commit references.
9. **Outcome:** Whether the interaction was successful, partially completed, or required rework.
**The primary objective is to establish traceability across the AI-assisted development lifecycle**, allowing us to understand how effectively AI was leveraged, which capabilities were utilized, and how the participant validated and refined the AI-generated output.

Ideally, these logs should be generated automatically wherever supported by the tool, rather than relying entirely on manual documentation. A structured JSON/JSONL log with a readable summary would be preferred.

The focus should be on **quality of AI utilization, transparency, and evidence of human oversight**, rather than simply the number of prompts or agents used.

 
Below is one such format you can refer, you can add more details if you think it makes sense:

{
  "id": "20261019T063542Z-agent-requirement-transcription",
  "timestamp": "2026-10-19T06:35:42Z",
  "stage": "setup",
  "agent": "agent",
  "agent_name": "<agent_name>",
  "agent_type": "<built-in | custom | sub-agent>",
  "ai_tool": "<ai_tool_name>",
  "model": "<model_name>",
  "mode": "<ask | plan | agent | edit>",
  "related_ids": [],
  "parent_task": null,
  "context": "Assignment for AI in SDLC",
  "request": "Analyse Assignment requirement",
  "skills_used": [
    {
      "name": "<skill_name>",
      "type": "<built-in | custom>",
      "purpose": "<skill_purpose>",
      "invocation": "<automatic | explicit>"
    }
  ],
  "subagents_used": [
    {
      "name": "<subagent_name>",
      "type": "<built-in | custom>",
      "task": "<delegated_task>",
      "status": "<completed | failed | partial>"
    }
  ],
  "mcp_tools_used": [
    {
      "server": "<mcp_server_name>",
      "tool": "<mcp_tool_name>",
      "purpose": "<purpose>"
    }
  ],
  "tools_used": [
    "<tool_name>"
  ],
  "suggestion": "<Any suggestions>",
  "human_decision": null,
  "action_verification": "<action verification>",
  "limitation": null,
  "status": "applied",
  "artifacts": [
    "requirement/complete-requirement.md"
  ]
}
